title: What happened?
grammar: Simple Past (-ed + irregulares) + did / didn't + first, then, after that, finally
today: Hoje você vai aprender a contar o que aconteceu: o que você fez ontem, no fim de semana, no sábado passado. E vai contar na ordem, igual fofoca boa: first, then, after that, finally!
canDo: Contar o que você fez: I worked, I went, I made
Perguntar What did you do? / Did you…?
Dizer o que você não fez: I didn't…
Contar uma história na ordem: first, then, after that, finally

video.context: A Sian, o Tim e a Georgie estão batendo papo sobre o fim de semana. Cada um conta o que fez — e o Tim fica bem interessado numa coisa que a Sian fez.
video.predict: Antes de ouvir: o que você acha que a Sian fez no fim de semana que deixou o Tim com água na boca? E será que sobrou pra ele?

questions.q: What did they play at the park?

vocab: Como foi o seu fim de semana?
went to the park and played frisbee
foi ao parque e jogou frisbee
foi nadar / leu um livro (read no passado soa "réd")

lines.text: Last Saturday, Rosa made a big chocolate cake.
First, she cooked all morning.
Then she visited Jenny in apartment 12.
After that, she came back at 3 o'clock.
Not again! Where is my cake? Max, what did you do?
The cake wasn't there. Only Max was there, and he looked very happy.
**Well**, I saw everything. Max **ate it all**!
Carlos wasn't happy. He went to the store and got a new cake. It was 25 dollars.
Finally, they all had cake at 5. Max? He didn't get any.

questions.q: What time did Rosa come back?
How much was the new cake?

chunks.pt: primeiro / depois / depois disso / finalmente (no fim)
chunks.tip: São as 4 palavrinhas que deixam qualquer fofoca na ordem. Coloca no começo da frase e pronto: a história anda sozinha!
examples: Then she visited Jenny in apartment 12.
Finally, they all had cake at 5.

alt: Finally, they all had cake at 6
Finally, they had cake at six

chunks.tip: Ate (pronuncia "êit") é o passado de eat. "Ate it all" = comeu tudinho, não sobrou nada. Serve pra qualquer pessoa: I, you, he, she, we, they ate it all.
examples: Sorry, Tim. My family ate it all.
He ate it all at 3 o'clock.

practice.pt: O cachorro comeu tudo no sábado.
practice.en: The dog ate it all on Saturday
alt: The dog ate it all last Saturday

chunks.tip: No passado regular, é só colocar -ed no verbo. E é igual pra todo mundo: I cooked, she cooked, they cooked. Sem -s, sem stress!
examples: Then she visited Jenny in apartment 12.

practice.pt: A Jenny cozinhou ontem à noite.

chunks.chunk: What did you do? / didn't / Did you…?
chunks.pt: O que você fez? / não (passado) / Você … (passado)?
chunks.tip: Na pergunta e no negativo do passado entra o did / didn't, e o verbo volta ao normal: Did you make? (e não Did you made?). He didn't get (e não He didn't got).

practice.pt: O que você fez no sábado?
practice.en: What did you do on Saturday?
alt: What did you do last Saturday?

chunks.pt: foi / pegou, comprou / fez / comeu, teve
chunks.tip: Esses verbos são irregulares: não levam -ed, mudam de cara. go → went, get → got, make → made, have → had. Decora como chunk: "went to the store", "made a cake", "had cake".
examples: Rosa made a big chocolate cake.
He went to the store and got a new cake.

practice.pt: Eu fiz um bolo no domingo.
practice.en: I made a cake on Sunday
alt: I made a cake last Sunday

grammar.title: Como funciona o passado
rows: eu fiz / eu comi, eu tive
Did you go? — Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
grammar.tip: Regra de ouro: com did ou didn't, o verbo volta ao normal. Did you went? ❌ → Did you go? ✅. E o passado é igual pra todo mundo: I went, he went, they went.

writing.prompt: Em português: escreva 3 frases contando o seu último fim de semana. Use first, then (ou after that) e finally.
writing.model: First, I went to the park on Saturday. Then I played frisbee with my brother. Finally, we had pizza at 8.

gossips.title: The Wrong Door

lines.text: Last Thursday, Tony got flowers for Jenny.
First, he turned left and went straight ahead.
Then he stopped at apartment 13.
A man opened the door.
Hi! These are for you, Jenny!
But it wasn't Jenny. It was Mr. Wilson. He's 80 years old.
**Wow**, thank you! I love flowers!
Tony didn't say a word. He walked back home.
After that, he got new flowers. They were 15 dollars.
Finally, he went to apartment 12. **This time**, Jenny opened the door!

options: Tony went to the wrong apartment
Tony got new flowers and went to apartment 12

questions.q: How much were the new flowers?

gossips.title: Max and the Cat

lines.text: Last Sunday, Carlos and Max went to the park.
First, they played frisbee for an hour.
Then Max saw a cat. He crossed the street and turned right.
Max! Come back!
Carlos **looked for** him for 30 minutes. No Max.
Finally, at 4:15, Rosa called him.
Carlos, your dog is in my kitchen! **Actually**, he's eating Lily's sandwich right now!
Carlos got a new sandwich for Lily. It was 8 dollars.

options: Max saw a cat and Carlos lost him
Rosa called Carlos: Max was in her kitchen
Max came back to the park
Lily found Max at the store

questions.q: What did Carlos get for Lily?

realtimes.title: O meu domingo
realtimes.pt: Ontem foi domingo. Primeiro, eu levantei às 9. Depois, eu fui ao parque com a minha irmã e nós jogamos frisbee. Depois disso, nós comemos pizza. A pizza foi 20 dólares. Às 3, nós voltamos pra casa. Eu não estudei inglês. Finalmente, eu fui dormir às 10 da noite. Foi divertido!
realtimes.model: Yesterday was Sunday. First, I got up at 9. Then I went to the park with my sister and we played frisbee. After that, we had pizza. The pizza was 20 dollars. At 3, we came back home. I didn't study English. Finally, I went to sleep at 10 p.m. It was fun!

realtimes.title: O bolo do Tony
realtimes.pt: O que o Tony fez na sexta passada? Ele fez um bolo pra Jenny. Primeiro, ele cozinhou a tarde toda. Depois, às 6, ele foi ao apartamento 12. Mas a Jenny não estava em casa: ela estava no hospital! Então o Tony voltou pra casa e comeu o bolo. Ele comeu tudo!
realtimes.model: What did Tony do last Friday? He made a cake for Jenny. First, he cooked all afternoon. Then, at 6, he went to apartment 12. But Jenny wasn't home: she was at the hospital! So Tony went back home and ate the cake. He ate it all!
